10.card: Boost your child's mental maths with both Abacus levels — faster calculation, sharper focus.
10.desc: This Abacus combo covers Levels 1 and 2, taking children from their first bead movements to confident, rapid mental calculation. Beyond arithmetic, Abacus training builds concentration, memory and visualisation that help across every subject. Sessions are patient, playful and one-on-one, matched to each child's pace.

11.card: Start your child's Abacus journey — Level 1 builds calculation speed, focus and confidence.
11.desc: Abacus Level 1 introduces children to the abacus and the foundations of fast mental maths. Through fun, structured practice they'll learn bead movements and begin calculating quickly in their heads, while building focus and confidence. It's a wonderful early-skills course delivered one-on-one.

12.card: Advance your child's Abacus skills — Level 2 builds speed, accuracy and mental calculation power.
12.desc: Abacus Level 2 builds on the basics toward genuinely impressive mental-maths ability. Children tackle larger numbers and more operations, sharpening speed, accuracy and visualisation. It continues to strengthen the concentration and confidence that carry over into all their schoolwork.

40.card: Give your child a taste of everything — a fun combo across coding, maths, robotics and creative skills.
40.desc: This all-courses combo lets children explore a range of skills — a bit of coding, maths, robotics and creativity — in one engaging programme. It's designed to spark curiosity, discover what they love, and build focus and confidence across the board. Playful, varied and paced perfectly for young learners.

108.card: Discover your child's natural strengths with DMIT — a scientific brain and aptitude assessment.
108.desc: DMIT (Dermatoglyphics Multiple Intelligence Test) uses fingerprint analysis to offer insight into a child's innate strengths and learning style. This short programme includes the assessment and a guided interpretation to help parents understand and nurture their child's natural potential. It's an insightful starting point for any learning journey.

118.card: Build your child's English and handwriting together — reading, speaking and neat writing in one combo.
118.desc: This combo pairs English learning with handwriting practice for a well-rounded start. Children build vocabulary, reading and speaking confidence alongside neat, legible handwriting, through fun and encouraging activities. It's an ideal foundation programme, taught patiently one-on-one.

119.card: Help your child love English — reading, speaking and vocabulary through fun, guided learning.
119.desc: This course builds young learners' English in a warm, playful way. Through stories, games and conversation, children grow their vocabulary, reading and speaking confidence at their own pace. It's a gentle, encouraging introduction that helps children genuinely enjoy the language.

147.card: Let kids design greeting cards in Canva — a fun, creative first step into digital design.
147.desc: This short, joyful course lets children create their own greeting cards using Canva. They'll learn basic design ideas — colour, layout, images and text — while making cards they're proud to share. It's a lovely, confidence-building introduction to digital creativity for young learners.

149.card: Transform your child's handwriting — neat, confident and legible writing through guided practice.
149.desc: Good handwriting builds confidence and helps in every subject at school. This course improves a child's letter formation, spacing and neatness through patient, structured practice and encouragement. Delivered one-on-one, it gives each child the attention that makes real, visible improvement.

159.card: Make multiplication effortless with Japanese Maths — a visual, fun method kids love.
159.desc: Japanese multiplication uses a clever visual, line-based method that makes multiplying feel like a game. This course teaches children this intuitive technique, building both speed and a genuine understanding of numbers. It's a fun, confidence-boosting way to make maths click for young learners.

205.card: Introduce your child to coding with HTML or Scratch — their first real step into programming.
205.desc: This course gives children a friendly first taste of programming through HTML or Scratch. They'll build simple web pages or interactive projects and games, learning logical thinking and creativity along the way. It's an encouraging, hands-on introduction that plants the seeds of a tech-savvy future.

217.card: Spark your child's love of STEM — build and program simple robots through hands-on play.
217.desc: This robotics course introduces children to building and programming their own simple robots. Through guided, hands-on activities they'll assemble mechanisms, add sensors and see their creations move — building curiosity, problem-solving and confidence. It's playful, encouraging and perfectly pitched for young learners.

243.card: Unlock lightning mental maths with Vedic Maths — ancient techniques for fast, confident calculation.
243.desc: Vedic Maths teaches clever shortcuts that make calculation remarkably fast and even fun. This course guides children through these ancient techniques for multiplication, division and more, building speed, accuracy and confidence with numbers. It's a delightful, focus-building boost to any child's maths ability.
